{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
df_completed['revenue'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any completed orders with converted == 1 and revenue == 999999.99
qa_check = df_completed[(df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99) & (df_completed['converted'] == 1)]
print(f'Completed, converted, QA-order check: {len(qa_check)}')"}
